== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
Source: [[Jim Colson]]'s collecting-thread post of 9 March 2003, reposted by [[Scott Lingrell]] on the Players Committee forum on 13 December 2005 (ref pcf-5796-113117), checked against the post text.

=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Colson lists this foil only under the "DSII Redemption Program", as the distributor order-validation card, "Only 500 in existance". The SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2 (p. 34) lists it twice: as a distributor foil for Death Star II (December 2000) and as a Reflections II wrapper redemption (June 2001; it also came with a Reflections box bought from Decipher's online store). [[Promotional Foils]] follows the Encyclopedia. If the foil was also a consumer wrapper redemption, Colson's figure of 500 may cover only the distributor copies, or one of the two sources is wrong. Both statements are kept on the card page, each with its own source.
